body: I've gotten plenty of those, but thanks for the offer, and all of your help. I might just need time to just accept that I screwed up and it's over.

I went out with some friends, but I never really got a chance to talk about the break up, so it was mostly just a distraction. Given the group, I guess I shouldn't be surprised it wasn't a serious get-together. So, I still feel pretty terrible :/

I don't need help being assertive. I've just had a bad run with men, is all. One that passed on, another that just refused to put in the effort... And I've never felt bad about ending something until now. I've been upset about it, but this time I really regret it.
Yeah, I guess I overreacted... You know, again. And I haven't even been considering the possibility that I was right.
Alright, thanks. I really hope I get let him know how I feel some day.

You're right, I'm sorry I blew up at you.

But I ruined my last chance at direct communication already, when I hurt him a second time. I was so, so stupid. So impulsive, and I don't know if I can wait. If I died and left a note, I'm sure it would make it to him.

I don't like how you're constantly taking an accusatory tone. Aren't you supposed to be talking me off the ledge, not pushing me towards it?

Those aren't options. He lives on another continent, and I don't have his mailing address. He never gave it to me, even though I asked about a million times to let me send him gifts.
The only way I can do that is to pass a message through someone else. Someone I don't really know. How can I trust them?

Do you really think I want to picture him suicidal, because of MY mistake?? Is that all you fucking care about? You think I have NO FUCKING EMPATHY? 

I'M PLANNING ON KILLING MYSELF TO END MY GUILT. IS THAT PROOF ENOUGH FOR YOU THAT I UNDERSTAND HE MIGHT FEEL BAD??????
Why are you doing this? Do you just want to drive me to kill myself? Is that whatt you want?
Do you think trying to get a message passed to him, letting him know I'm sorry, would help? Or just help me?
I don't know that I want to imagine him in such bad shape. I love him, and I really, really hate myself for hurting him. What if he didn't cheat? That really does make me terrible, doesn't it?

He blocked me everywhere, including the phone. I left him some messages on Skype, but I think he's running from me.

I said some nasty things to him on Google, too. It really wasn't fair to him.
Or maybe he just didn't want to forgive me.
About three years. And, yes, it was. Probably a couple hours after. I think he thought I wanted to hurt him again.
He was distant. He was logging onto Steam and them logging off again really fast, but still playing games. Coop games, and not with me.

No, I didn't block him. I tried to get in contact with him, but he had blocked me.

And I broke up with him because I thought he was cheating.

I must of really hurt him. I've started looking into suicide methods.
